annotation.title_clean: H.R. 1186 — Curbing Realistic Exploitative Electronic Pedophilic Robots Act 2.0 (CREEPER Act 2.0)
annotation.title_en: H.R. 1186 — Curbing Realistic Exploitative Electronic Pedophilic Robots Act 2.0 (CREEPER Act 2.0)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. House of Representatives, 119th Congress (Rep. Buchanan; Rep. Moskowitz)
annotation.summary_en: US House bill (CREEPER Act 2.0), introduced February 2025, amending Title 18 to ban importing, moving across state lines, trafficking and possessing child sex dolls and robots. It defines these as anatomically correct dolls, mannequins or robots that resemble minors and are meant for sexual acts. Offenders face fines and prison terms.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines 'child sex doll' as an anatomically correct doll, mannequin, or robot resembling a minor intended for sexual acts
Adds child sex dolls to 18 U.S.C. 1462 prohibition on importation/transportation of obscene matter
Creates new 18 U.S.C. 1471 offence for buying, selling, distributing or possessing trafficked child sex dolls
Penalties up to 5 years imprisonment for first offence, 10 years for subsequent offences
Congressional findings claim such robots normalize child abuse and can simulate rape
